expanded_title: In the Booth Tonight With Coach Hayden Fortini: Special $1/$3 Cash-Game Livestream at Champions Social Club
expanded_deck: Joining poker coach Hayden Fortini in the Champions Social Club commentary booth for a special $1/$3 cash-game broadcast with live strategy Q&A in the chat.
expanded_body:
Originally posted September 29, 2026.

I'm in the commentary booth tonight at Champions Social Club with a great poker mind: Coach Hayden Fortini.

Tune in for a special $1/$3 cash-game livestream as we break down the hands in real time and get inside Hayden's head on low-stakes cash-game adjustments. Jump in the live chat and ask him anything — cards fly at 6:30 p.m. CT. Let's go!

— Sham
author: Shomari Williams
